The '''Derby de Lisboa''' or '''Dérbi de Lisboa'''{{efn|Also known as '''Dérbi Eterno''' (eternal derby), '''Dérbi dos Dérbis''' (derby of the derbies), '''Dérbi da Segunda Circular''' (Segunda Circular derby), '''Dérbi da Capital''' (derby of the [[capital city|capital]])}} (English: [[Lisbon]] derby) is the biggest [[List of association football club rivalries in Europe#Portugal|football derby match in Portugal]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Pestana|first=José|date=9 December 2016|title=Benfica-Sporting: 'Águia' retomou controlo do dérbi com golo de Mitroglou|trans-title=Benfica-Sporting: 'Eagle' regained control of the derby with a goal by Mitroglou|url=https://www.futebol365.pt/artigo/161701-benfica-sporting-aguia-retomou-controlo-do-derbi-com-golo-de-mitroglou/|language=pt|work=Futebol 365|access-date=22 May 2023|quote=maior dérbi do futebol português}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Pires|first=Bruno|date=22 April 2017|title="O lagartão" vaidoso e o "líder" que não dizia palavrões|trans-title=The vain "lizard" and the "leader" who did not curse|url=https://www.dn.pt/desporto/o-lagartao-vaidoso-e-o-lider-que-nao-dizia-palavroes-6236445.html|language=pt|work=Diário de Notícias|access-date=22 May 2023|quote=maior dérbi do futebol português}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|date=2 December 2021|title=Delegada de saúde considera que vai haver dérbi entre Benfica e Sporting, embora a situação esteja a ser avaliada diariamente|trans-title=Health officer considers that there will a derby between Benfica and Sporting, despite the situation being assessed daily|url=https://tribuna.expresso.pt/revista-de-imprensa/2021-12-02-Delegada-de-saude-considera-que-vai-haver-derbi-entre-Benfica-e-Sporting-embora-a-situacao-esteja-a-ser-avaliada-diariamente-39b58adb|language=pt|work=Tribuna Expresso|access-date=22 May 2023|quote=maior dérbi do país}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|date=14 April 2022|title=Rivalidade e expressão internacional do dérbi de Lisboa em documentário na FIFA+|trans-title=|url=https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/noticias/rivalidade-e-expressao-internacional-do-derbi-de-lisboa-em-documentario-na-fifa-14771884.html|language=pt|work=O Jogo|access-date=22 May 2023|quote=maior dérbi português}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Azevedo|first=Pedro Miguel|date=14 January 2023|title=Rafa e Coates são os reis do dérbi entre Benfica e Sporting: confira os números|trans-title=Rafa and Coates are the kings of the derby between Benfica and Sporting|url=https://www.ojogo.pt/futebol/1a-liga/noticias/rafa-e-coates-sao-os-reis-do-derbi-entre-benfica-e-sporting-confira-os-numeros-15656597.html|language=pt|work=O Jogo|access-date=22 May 2023|quote=maior dérbi português}}</ref> It is played between Lisbon-based clubs [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] and [[Sporting CP|Sporting]], two of the [[List of football clubs by competitive honours won|most decorated clubs in the country]] and members of [[Big Three (Portugal)|Portugal's "Big Three" clubs]]. The rivalry originated in 1907 when eight Benfica players moved to Sporting before the first derby between them.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/1625115-dortmund-vs-bayern-munich-and-europes-6-premier-rivarlies-right-now#slide2|title=Benfica vs. Sporting Lisbon: Derby De Lisboa|last=Gannon|first=Willie|date=3 May 2013|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|access-date=3 January 2015}}</ref> The derby is generally an intense affair within the city of Lisbon and a significant event for the [[Portuguese diaspora]] worldwide.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.au/football/story/_/id/37416364/when-sporting-meet-benfica-historical-rivalry-leads-new-tensions |title=When Sporting meet Benfica, historical rivalry leads to new tensions|website=ESPN|date=18 March 2015|access-date=15 February 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/stories/classicderby/news/newsid=1547990.html|title=So close, so far for Lisbon rivals|website=FIFA|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121031022559/http://www.fifa.com/classicfootball/stories/classicderby/news/newsid=1547990.html|archive-date=31 October 2012|access-date=30 June 2015}}</ref>

==Reserve team matches==
[[S.L. Benfica B|Benfica B]] and [[Sporting CP B|Sporting B]] were established in the late 90s. They folded following the end of the 2005–06 season and were re-established in 2012 to compete starting from the [[2012–13 Segunda Liga]].{{citation needed|date=October 2025}}

In 2018, Sporting B were again extinct after their relegation in the [[2017–18 LigaPro]].

==Records and statistics==

===Benfica===
[[File:Benfica sporting.JPG|thumb|right|400px|Chart showing the finishing league positions of Benfica (red) and Sporting (green) between the 1934–35 and 2009–10 seasons]]
* '''Benfica's biggest home win:''' Benfica 7–2 Sporting (28 April 1948){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* Benfica 5–0 Sporting (3 December 1939){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* Benfica 5–0 Sporting (19 November 1978){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* Benfica 5–0 Sporting (12 March 1986){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Benfica's biggest away win:''' Sporting 0–4 Benfica (27 February 1910){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Benfica's most consecutive wins:''' 8 (25 October 1908 – 10 March 1912){{citation needed|date=October 2025}}
* '''Benfica's longest undefeated run:''' 14 (25 October 1908 – 17 January 1915){{citation needed|date=October 2025}}
* '''Benfica's most consecutive losses:''' 5 (5 October 1952 – 23 May 1954){{citation needed|date=October 2025}}
* '''Benfica's most consecutive matches without winning:''' 5 (29 November 1980 – 2 January 1983){{citation needed|date=October 2025}}

===Sporting===
* '''Sporting's biggest home win:''' Sporting 7–1 (14 December 1986){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Sporting's biggest away win:''' Benfica 0–5 Sporting (18 October 1936){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* Benfica 0–5 Sporting (14 December 1941){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Sporting's most consecutive wins:''' 5 (5 October 1952 – 23 May 1954){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Sporting's longest undefeated run:''' 5 (29 November 1980 – 2 January 1983){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Sporting's most consecutive losses:''' 8 (25 October 1908 – 10 March 1912){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}
* '''Sporting's most consecutive matches without winning:''' 14 (25 October 1908 – 17 January 1915){{citation needed|date=May 2026}}

== Women's matches ==
The first women's official derby was played on 19 October 2019 for matchday 3 of the [[2019–20 Campeonato Nacional de Futebol Feminino|2019–20 National Championship]]. [[S.L. Benfica (women's football)|Benfica]] beat [[Sporting CP (women's football)|Sporting]] 3–0 at the [[Estádio da Luz]], and the overall attendance record for a women's match in Portugal was surpassed with 12,812 spectators in the stands.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://observador.pt/2019/10/19/benfica-vence-sporting-na-luz-e-sai-a-ganhar-no-primeiro-derbi-oficial-de-futebol-feminino/|title=Benfica vence Sporting na Luz e sai a ganhar no primeiro dérbi oficial de futebol feminino|trans-title=Benfica beat Sporting at Da Luz and come out winning in the first official football derby|last=Fernandes|first=Mariana|work=Observador|language=pt|access-date=20 October 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|date=19 October 2019|title=Benfica vence primeiro dérbi feminino e assume liderança isolada do campeonato|trans-title=Benfica win first women's derby and take the lead in the league|url=https://desporto.sapo.pt/futebol/futebol-feminino/artigos/benfica-vence-primeiro-derbi-feminino|language=pt|work=SAPO Desporto|access-date=22 October 2019}}</ref> The current attendance record is 27,221 spectators, set on 26 March 2023 at Estádio da Luz.<ref>[https://www.abola.pt/nnh/2023-03-26/futebol-feminino-historico-derbi-na-luz-bate-recorde-de-assistencia-em-portugal/981507 HISTÓRICO: dérbi na Luz bate recorde de assistência em Portugal!]</ref>
